description: Tests must match specification scenarios exactly. Test names, steps, and assertions verify exactly what the scenario states. Use exact variable names and terminology from specification. Example: agent_name='story_bot' (from spec), not name='bot'

do.description: Test matches specification exactly. Example: GIVEN config exists, WHEN Agent(agent_name='story_bot'), THEN config_path == agents/base/agent.json

guidance.description: Test name and docstring match scenario
example: WHEN: Agent is initialized with agent_name='story_bot'
THEN: Agent sets up config path at agents/base/agent.json'''

guidance.description: Use exact variable names from specification
Assert exactly what scenario states - no more, no less

dont.description: Don't use different terminology or assert things not in specification. Example: assert agent._internal_flag (not in spec - wrong)

guidance.description: Don't use vague or different terminology
example: def test_agent_init():  # WRONG - spec says 'initializes with base config'

guidance.description: Don't assert implementation details not in spec
example: assert agent._internal_flag == True  # WRONG - not in spec
